notes: Premium is per person. For a couple, each spouse needs a plan, so double the annual premium and the out-of-pocket exposure (the app currently doubles individual amounts for a married couple).
Medical deductible is $0, so every service pays its copay or coinsurance from the first dollar.

Several services have a price per site of service (imaging, X-ray, diagnostic tests, surgery). The file holds one site per service; the others are in each service's limits text. Adjust Evaluator prices if you use a different site.
Part D has its own $700 deductible for tiers 4 and 5 and a $2,400 prescription out-of-pocket cap (limits.drug_deductible, limits.drug_oop_max).

assumptions: Source is the 2027 Summary of Benefits only; the Evidence of Coverage was not read.
The drug tier fields hold the retail pharmacy, 30-day amounts; all six pharmacy columns (retail, standard mail order, preferred mail order, each 30 and 100 days) are in drugs.pharmacy_channels.

Where a price differs by site of service, the file uses: freestanding radiological facility for X-rays ($40) and advanced imaging ($205), specialist's office for diagnostic tests ($20), ambulatory surgery center for surgery ($0; outpatient hospital surgery is $450), and a diabetic supplier for diabetic supplies (20%). Other sites are in each limits text.
service_area lists King County only (the county of the other plan files); the plan also serves Kitsap, Pierce and Snohomish.
Skilled nursing: $221 per day for days 21-100 is entered with max_units 80; the $10 per day for days 1-20 is not modeled.
network.emergency_out_of_network_pays_in_network_rates is left null: the booklet lists worldwide emergency and urgent care costs but does not say how out-of-network emergency claims are paid.
Dental: the $4,000 yearly maximum covers preventive and comprehensive dental together, so cleanings count toward it. It is treated as per person.
notes: Plan ID H1036-321 comes from the plan name and document code H1036321000.
Medical maximum out-of-pocket is $5,900 in network; no out-of-network coverage except emergency and urgent care.
Outpatient hospital surgery is $450 but the ambulatory surgery center price is $0, so the surgery price is much lower if the surgery is done at a surgery center.
Home health, surgeon fees and hospital physician fees are not listed in the Summary of Benefits, so they are 'unknown'.
The Summary of Benefits gives no Star Rating, Part B premium or plan page URL, so they are left out.
Rechecked on 2026-10-27 against H1036321000SB27.pdf: premium, deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums and the dental terms (cleaning, root canal, crown, annual maximum) match this file.
